# ⚠️ Stop! Do Not Submit Security Issues Publicly

If you have discovered a potential security vulnerability in KubeView, please **do NOT** submit this public issue.

Public disclosure places Kubernetes clusters and users at risk before a patch can be developed and distributed.

---

## 🛡️ Responsible Disclosure Procedure

1. **GitHub Security Advisory (Recommended):**
   Submit a private report via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/PorKeat/KubeView/security/advisories/new).

2. **Direct Security Contact:**
   Email our maintainers confidentially at: `security@kubeview.dev`

For complete details on our coordinated disclosure process, response SLAs, and scope, please review our [Security Policy](https://github.com/PorKeat/KubeView/blob/main/SECURITY.md).

Thank you for helping keep KubeView secure!
